title: Signal Converter Manifest
description: Schema for the stage 2 manifest written by the extract-signals skill. Tracks per-skeleton progress, splitting decisions, routing, and issues for the LLM signal-formulation step of Signal Extraction.

status.description: Overall status of the stage 2 run.

round.description: Round number from stage 1. All Signal Cards produced carry this round value.

total_skeletons_found.description: Total number of skeleton files enumerated across all batch directories at startup.

skeletons_processed.description: Number of skeletons fully processed (success, recovery-staged, or structurally failed).

cards_written.description: Number of Signal Cards written to working/signal_extraction/cards/. May exceed skeletons_processed when splitting occurred.

cards_recovery_staged.description: Number of Signal Cards staged to working/signal_extraction/signal_gpt_recovery/ because they could not satisfy the schema.

skeleton_failures.description: Number of skeletons that failed structural validation (skeleton_invalid) and produced no output.

needs_human_review_count.description: Number of cards flagged needs_human_review. These are in cards/ (valid) but require operator attention.

splits_performed.description: Number of skeletons that were split into more than one Signal Card. Useful telemetry for assessing how often records contain multiple discrete claims.

next_signal_id_counter.description: The next available signal_id sequence number for this round. Initialized from signal_id_counter_at_stage1 in the stage 1 manifest. Incremented each time stage 2 allocates an additional ID (e.g., during splitting). Persisted so resumption does not re-use IDs.

processed_skeletons.description: Per-skeleton log. Appended after each skeleton completes. Enables resumability and per-skeleton audit.

issues.description: Run-level issues (e.g., missing contract or schema files). Per-skeleton issues are recorded in processed_skeletons entries.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when stage 2 first started. Null if status is pending.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when stage 2 completed. Null while in progress.

skeleton_signal_id.description: signal_id from the skeleton file that was processed (the stage 1 assigned ID).

cards_produced.description: One entry per Signal Card produced from this skeleton. Empty if the skeleton was structurally invalid.

issues_for_this_skeleton.description: Issue types registered for this skeleton during stage 2 processing.

issue_detail.description: Human-readable detail for the primary issue, if any.

processed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this skeleton was processed.

signal_id.description: signal_id assigned to this card. May differ from skeleton_signal_id if splitting allocated additional IDs.
